main.description: Index again the firehose events whose handler kept failing (the indexer's failedEvents), oldest first, from the current state of the PDS: records that still exist are indexed, records that are gone are deleted, accounts take their current status. Events that index are removed from the list; others stay with their new error. Indexer admins (the safety admins) only; requires service auth for the indexer.

limit.description: Most events to replay in this call.

replayed.description: Events indexed and removed from the list.

remaining.description: Events still in the list, including the ones that failed again.
